text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
D-D-Doto and Fukukitaru's...!
'Thank-you Palmer-san BBQ' is officially open, yesss!

text_block_list.name: Palmer & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yaaay!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Today is to thank you, Palmer-san...!
For always doing point-and-call checks of our belongings with us,
and for—!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
And I will never forget how you cheered me up
when my fortune-telling went wrong!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, you two!
I'm totally expecting some delicious grub♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us ignite the fire... ignite!
...Ignite... I-It's not lighting up~~!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeh~~~!?
The charcoal is all wet~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, magnificent...! Fresh squid blessed by
Lady Shiraoki really is on another level♪

text_block_list.name: Squid
text_block_list.text: *(Squirm squirm squirm~~~)*

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
KYAAAAH~~~!?
I-I-I-It's aliiiiive~~~!!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um, if I recall, the fresh charcoal is over here—

text_block_list.name: Squid
text_block_list.text: *(SQUUUUURT—!!)*

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Hyowah!? Sudden total darkness, a cataclysmic omen!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fueeeh~~~!
This isn't that kind of charcoal ink~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, all wiped clean.
You two doing okay?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! We'll cook right away,
so please just relax, guest of honor Palmer-san!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
We won't fail again!
We d-d-definitely want to make you happy!

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru & Doto
text_block_list.text: WAHHHHHHH~~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Both the squid and the vegetables are pitch black...
We rushed the grilling way too much~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm so sorryyy~~.
We couldn't even thank you properly... *sniffle*.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
There, there... It's all right.
Look—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Mmmmmm~~~, that's an acquired taste!
But it's delicious!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh?! A-Are you sure you're
not pushing yourself too hard?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nah, not at all!
I totally loved it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
'Cause look, both of your feelings are packed right into it.
It's delicious, and my heart feels totally full!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Thanks so much, Doto! Fukukitaru!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Palmer-saaan...!
Next time, I'll definitely make it way, waaay tastierrr~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sounds awesome! Well then, why don't we all
brainstorm ways to make it even tastier together!

text_block_list.name: Fukukitaru & Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am...!

One day, when I stopped by a family
restaurant to grab dinner—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, the oracle has spoken! Lady Shiraoki says
the key to success lies in prep work!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, like chopping up the ingredients beforehand.
That way, we might be able to cook at our own pace...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Nice ideas, you two♪
Next time's gonna be a super-duper mega-success for sure!

Seeing the three of them chatting with beaming smiles
brightened up my own spirits as well!
